title: Herbal Crisp Syrian Vegetable Stew
description: A light and refreshing Syrian stew featuring a blend of herbs, crisp vegetables, and a hint of cider, perfect for a vegan-friendly meal. This stew is boiled to perfection, creating a delicious and healthy dish.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper, cooking for 5 minutes, until they start to soften.
Pour in the apple cider and vegetable broth, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley, sumac, and salt to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
